content.short: CardanoRace is - collectible Digital Art future game with play to earn mechanics.
content.description: CardanoRace - is a future Play 2 Earn Cardano NFT game. Collect cars, upgrade them with NITRO tokens, which is the main in-game currency for upgrades and other activities, such as Re-Mint your car with special parts and making your own tuned-up version, which will increase the chances of winning games and earn ADA!
